data.narrative:
Picogrid, a Series A defense and security company that has raised $45M+, is evaluated against a peer set of 11 same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base value, applies a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier to the $45M raised, yielding $90M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company set produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M (low) to $3.0B (high). The peer set includes recent Series B valuations: Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Twenty at $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $76M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $545M. The wide spread reflects two competing signals: stage-progression methods anchor conservatively near raised capital, while peer-median valuation reflects sector momentum and growth expectations in Defense & Security. Key uncertainties include revenue traction and customer concentration, neither captured in the data provided. The median estimate of $545M reflects the tension between earlier-stage mechanics and peer-set positioning, with meaningful downside risk if unit economics or customer acquisition prove weaker than sector peers.
